record.question: Mr. Hminga’s monthly salary is Rs.25,000 (HRA not included). He donated Rs.10,000 to a charitable trust eligible for 50% deduction under 80G of Income Tax Act. He contributes Rs.1,500 per month towards provident fund and pays Rs.4,000 per month towards life insurance policy. Calculate the income tax payable in last month of the year if he had been paying Rs.1,300 per month towards income tax for the first 11 months. (6) Use the following for calculating income tax : (a) Rate of tax :Slab Income tax i) Where the taxable income does not exceed Rs.1,00,000 Nil (b) ii) Where the taxable income exceeds Rs. 1,00,000 but does not exceed Rs.1,50,000 10% of the amount by which taxable income exceeds Rs.1,00,000 iii) Where the taxable income exceeds Rs.1,50,000 but does not exceed Rs.2,50,000 Rs.5,000 + 20% of the amount by which the taxable income exceeds Rs.1,50,000 iv) Where the taxable income exceeds Rs.2,50,000 Rs.25,000 + 30% of the amount by which the taxable income exceeds Rs.2,50,000 (v) Surcharge : 10% of the amount of tax if the taxable income exceeds Rs.10,00,000 (vi) Education cess : 2% of the amount of tax payable. Concession for savings : Notified savings (P.F., LIC, PPF, Mutual funds, etc.) upto Rs.1,00,000 are exempted from payment of tax.
record.direction: Written question — follow the original paper instructions. No MCQ answer index applies.
